title: Chapter 150 Killing Terkel
content:
Chapter 150 Killing Terkel

"Pfft."

Tekker spat out a mouthful of blood and phlegm, his expression was cold, and his heart was even more unconvinced, and he cursed: "Grandpa, I would rather die than surrender! Even if I die, I will peel off a layer of your skin."

After several rounds of attacks, his health value has reached the bottom.

"Don't worry, the boss will avenge me!"

Wang Shuo shook his head and shot him directly.

[You killed Tekker, the fourth boss of Qingmu Village. ]

Wang Shuo chose to turn off the display of ID and other information, so the display of the kill became much simpler.

Pick up the items dropped on the ground.

[Soul Crystal +2, Energy Crystal +150, "Falling Leaf Knife Technique" +1, Military General Transfer Certificate +1. ]

Seeing the fallen military general transfer certificate, Wang Shuo finally smiled.

This battle can be said to be a great victory, mainly because of the credit of the city wall.

If the bandits rushed into the village, it would inevitably suffer some losses.

"Clean up the battlefield."

There were only more than 30 bandits killed, and most of them ran away.

In order to kill this general, Wang Shuo had to give up chasing other bandits.

Wang Shuo counted all the soul crystals.

The total number in the backpack surprisingly reached 170.

This is the number consumed by building energy towers.

In the ancient battlefield, killing bosses, especially in the village defense battle, got 120.

Wang Shuo was very happy.

At this time, there was a message in Wang Shuo's friend message that aroused his vigilance.

This was sent back by a spy he sent out.

"Lord, Fengze Village has unified the nearby villages within 40 miles, and the number of people has exceeded a thousand. They plan to attack Wana Village."

Wang Shuo's heart tightened. The pace of expansion of Fengze Village has been very rapid recently.

There are even rumors that it is now the first village.

Wang Shuo had to take it seriously.

"Wait and see." Wang Shuo replied.

The current main task is to vigorously develop military strength.

"Ayub, continue to brush military merit points, we need more soldiers."

He has now lowered the standard to B-level qualifications. After all, the attributes of the territory can improve the qualifications of the first-level citizens.

"Yes, Lord!"

Then, he thought of something and said to Guliji: "Now, find a way to investigate the situation of Qingmu Village. We must destroy this bandit den."

"Yes, Lord!"

Guliji is an assassin. She has reached level 22 and has mastered a stealth skill of "stealth". It should be no problem to spy on intelligence.

At noon, Wang Shuo inspected the territory again.

Suo Yong has organized people to build fish ponds and reclaim farmland.

Inside the city wall, a large area of land was reclaimed. Farmers used their skills to quickly turn the soil and sow seeds, which looked very magical.

Wang Shuo was stunned. After a while, a 50-square-meter piece of land was sown.

In the fish pond next to it, many masons were tamping the embankment, and farmers were planting saplings to protect the embankment.

Soon, there will be willows hanging down and lotus flowers fragrant.

Further away, there is a fence surrounding the breeding ground, and several stone houses have been built next to it so that livestock can take shelter when it rains.

Wang Shuo suddenly became full of longing and looked forward to his future life.

He must work hard to protect his thriving village.
